name: Forehand block against topspin
purpose: Meet a topspin ball early with a firm, slightly closed bat and send it back with control.

variants.instructions: Your partner loops steadily to your forehand. You block every ball back to their forehand. Swap after each set.
The feeder sends medium-fast topspin to your forehand. Block each ball back cross-court, close to the table.
variants.feederInstructions: Feed topspin with a brushing action, a bit faster than a normal rally. Same spot every ball.

variants.instructions: Robot on medium-fast topspin to your forehand. Stand close and block every ball cross-court.

coachingPoints: Bat in front, slightly closed
Meet it early, just after the bounce
Short, firm push forward; no backswing

name: Backhand block against topspin
purpose: The safe backhand answer to a loop: angle the bat, meet it early, let the ball's speed do the work.

variants.instructions: Your partner loops to your backhand. You block back to their forehand, then switch roles.
Topspin balls to your backhand. Block each one diagonally, staying close.
variants.feederInstructions: Medium-fast topspin to their backhand, steady rhythm.

variants.instructions: Robot on medium-fast topspin to your backhand. Block back, close to the table.

coachingPoints: Bat angled forward over the ball
Take it on the rise
Relaxed grip absorbs speed, firm grip adds it

name: Block, forehand and backhand
purpose: Block from both wings and switch fast, recovering to the middle each time.

variants.instructions: Your partner loops one to your backhand and one to your forehand. Block both back to them. Later they loop anywhere.
Topspin alternating backhand and forehand. Block every ball.
variants.feederInstructions: Topspin, backhand then forehand. When steady, add a ball to the middle.

variants.instructions: Robot oscillating between your backhand and forehand on topspin. Block every ball.

success.description: 12 blocks in a row, both wings.

coachingPoints: Bat back to the middle after each block
Decide the wing early
Keep the knees bent

name: Forehand loop against a block
purpose: Keep looping against a block: a shorter, more forward swing than against backspin.

variants.instructions: Your partner blocks to your forehand. Loop every ball back to their backhand, steady pace.
Topspin balls to your forehand, one at a time. Loop each one deep.
variants.feederInstructions: Feed light topspin to their forehand, deep, one ball every 1.5 seconds.

variants.instructions: Robot on light topspin to your forehand. Loop every ball, sets of 15.

coachingPoints: Swing more forward than up
Close the bat over the ball
Recover fast: the block comes back quickly

name: Counter-loop rally
purpose: Loop against a loop from a step back: take it after the peak and spin through it.

variants.instructions: Both of you a step or two back. Loop to loop, forehand cross-court. Count your longest rally.
Stand 2 metres back. The feeder sends heavy, deep topspin; counter-loop each ball.
variants.feederInstructions: Heavy topspin, deep to their forehand. Brush hard; it should kick after the bounce.

variants.instructions: Robot on heavy, deep topspin. Stand back and counter-loop each ball.

coachingPoints: Give yourself room: a step back
Swing forward and over the ball
Use legs and hips, not just the arm

name: Backhand topspin against backspin
purpose: Open with the backhand: lift a backspin ball using forearm and wrist from in front of the body.

variants.instructions: Backspin balls to your backhand, one at a time. Topspin each one deep, sets of 10.
variants.feederInstructions: Backspin to their backhand, half-long to long. Wait until they recover.

variants.instructions: Robot on backspin to your backhand, slow-medium. Topspin each ball.
Your partner pushes long to your backhand. Topspin it and play the point out.

success.description: 7 of 10 backhand topspins on the table.

coachingPoints: Elbow forward, bat drops below the ball
Wrist cocks back, then whips up and forward
Contact in front of your body

name: Backhand topspin rally
purpose: Keep a backhand topspin going against a block or a drive.

variants.instructions: Your partner blocks to your backhand. Topspin every ball back to their backhand.
Light topspin to your backhand. Topspin each ball diagonally.
variants.feederInstructions: Light topspin to their backhand, steady rhythm.

variants.instructions: Robot on light topspin to your backhand. Topspin each ball back, sets of 15.

coachingPoints: Brush up and forward
Short stroke, quick reset
Weight slightly forward

name: Forehand flick against a short ball
purpose: Attack a short ball over the table: step in, short backswing, flick up and forward.

variants.instructions: Short backspin balls to your forehand. Step in and flick each one, sets of 10.
variants.feederInstructions: Short balls that would bounce twice on their side, to the forehand. Light backspin at first.

variants.instructions: Your partner serves short to your forehand. Flick every serve and play the point out.
If your robot can play short: short backspin to your forehand. Step in and flick.

coachingPoints: Right foot under the table (left foot if left-handed)
Bat starts close to the ball
Lift against backspin, go forward against no-spin

name: Backhand flick against a short ball
purpose: Attack short balls with the backhand over the table.

variants.instructions: Short balls to your backhand. Step in, elbow up, flick each ball. Sets of 10.
variants.feederInstructions: Short balls to their backhand, light backspin or no-spin.

variants.instructions: Your partner serves short to your backhand. Flick it and play on.
If your robot can play short: short balls to your backhand. Flick each one.

coachingPoints: Elbow high and forward
Wrist cocks back, then flicks out
Contact at the top of the bounce, over the table

name: Short game duel
purpose: Keep the ball short and low until someone can attack. Touch, patience and placement.

variants.instructions: Serve short. Both of you return everything short. The first ball that goes long can be attacked. Count who wins.
Short balls anywhere. Drop every one short. If the feeder calls 'long', push it long instead.
variants.feederInstructions: Short balls to random spots. Now and then call 'long'.

coachingPoints: Soft hands, early contact
Tiny stroke, almost a touch
Step in and out every time

name: Drop it short
purpose: Return short backspin so it would bounce twice on the other side.

variants.instructions: Short backspin balls to one spot. Drop each one back short and low.
variants.feederInstructions: Short backspin, close to the net on their side.

variants.instructions: If your robot can play short: short backspin to your forehand. Drop each one short.
Your partner serves short backspin. Drop it back short every time.

coachingPoints: Take it early, right after the bounce
Bat open, almost no swing
Relax your grip

name: Smash the high ball
purpose: Finish a high ball with a fast, flat hit: step, wait for the top of the bounce, hit through.

variants.instructions: High balls to your forehand. Smash each one to a target. Sets of 8.
variants.feederInstructions: Throw or feed high, easy balls that bounce up to about head height.

variants.instructions: Your partner lobs from far back. Smash to their forehand and backhand in turn.
Robot on high, slow balls if it can. Smash each one.

coachingPoints: Move so the ball comes down in front of you
Hit at the top of the bounce
Flat bat, hit through the ball

name: Chop against topspin
purpose: Return a loop with heavy backspin from far back: long stroke, down and forward.

variants.instructions: Your partner loops slowly to one side. Chop every ball back low and deep. Start backhand, then forehand.
Robot on slow topspin, deep. Stand 2 metres back and chop each ball.
Topspin balls deep to one side. Chop each one, then step back into position.
variants.feederInstructions: Slow, deep topspin. Same side for a set, then switch.

success.description: 10 chops in a row, low over the net.

coachingPoints: Start high, finish low and forward
Contact as the ball drops, beside the body
Step back with the stroke

name: Chop, forehand and backhand
purpose: Move side to side and chop from both wings, staying far from the table.

variants.instructions: Your partner loops one to your forehand, one to your backhand. Chop both. Later they loop anywhere.
Robot oscillating with slow topspin. Chop forehand and backhand.
Deep topspin alternating sides. Chop and recover each time.
variants.feederInstructions: Slow, deep topspin: forehand, backhand, repeat.

success.description: 8 chops in a row, switching sides.

coachingPoints: Big side steps
Turn the shoulders with each chop
Back to the middle every time

name: Lob rally
purpose: Stay in the point when attacked: high, deep, spinny returns from far back.

variants.instructions: One of you smashes at three-quarter speed, the other lobs from far back. Swap after 2 minutes.
Stand 3 metres back. The feeder hits flat balls deep; lob each one high and deep.
variants.feederInstructions: Hit firm, flat balls deep to them from your end.

success.description: 6 lobs in a row, landing deep.

coachingPoints: Lift from low to high with topspin
Aim deep, near the end line
Recover back, don't creep forward
